item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 02/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to southern China over the weekend to midweek next week. Winds are expected to be weak over the coast of Guangdong early next week. High temperatures may trigger showers and thunderstorms.

Wind: Light winds force 2.
Weather: Mainly fine. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
